chunks: Al-Husayn ibn Sa'id, from Ibn Abi 'Umayr, from 'Umar ibn Udhaynah, from 'Ubayd ibn Zurarah, from his father, who said:
Abu Ja'far عليه السلام led us in salat (prayer) wearing a single garment.

key_terms.أَبُو جَعْفَرٍ: Imam Abu Ja'far عليه السلام, the Imam referred to in the report
key_terms.ثَوْبٍ: a garment or piece of clothing
key_terms.عَلَيْهِ ٱلسَّلَامُ: peace be upon him; honorific for the Imam

ai.seo_question: Is it permissible to perform salat (prayer) in a single garment according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith reports that Abu Ja'far عليه السلام performed salat (prayer) with the people while wearing a single garment. It serves as evidence in the jurisprudence of prayer regarding the permissibility of praying in one garment.
